== ConLeche/Denotes.lean#L270-L290
   270  structure Model (V : Type w) [SetTheory V] (env : Env) where
   271    /-- the set a constant denotes, per level assignment -/
   272    cval : Name → (LevelParam → Nat) → V
   273    /-- every stored constant is a member of what its type denotes, at
   274    every level assignment (and every variable environment — the type
   275    is closed) -/
   276    mem : ∀ c ∈ env.consts, ∀ (φ : LevelParam → Nat) (ρ : BVarIdx → V),
   277      ∃ T, Denotes cval env φ ρ c.toConstantVal.type T ∧ cval c.name φ ∈ˢ T
   278    /-- whatever the built-in `False` denotes is the empty set -/
   279    false_empty : ∀ (φ : LevelParam → Nat) (ρ : BVarIdx → V) (F : V),
   280      Denotes cval env φ ρ (.const falseName []) F → F = empty
   281    /-- whatever the built-in `Eq` denotes is set equality: at a type `A`
   282    of the universe the level `u` names, and two of its members `a` and
   283    `b`, `@Eq.{u} A a b` denotes the truth value of `a = b`.  The three
   284    membership premises are the graph's domains — `Eq`'s denotation is a
   285    three-fold graph over `univ (Level.eval φ u)`, then over `A`, then
   286    over `A` again, and a graph read off its domain says nothing -/
   287    eq_equality : ∀ (u : Level) (φ : LevelParam → Nat) (ρ : BVarIdx → V) (E A a b : V),
   288      Denotes cval env φ ρ (.const eqName [u]) E →
   289      A ∈ˢ univ (Level.eval φ u) → a ∈ˢ A → b ∈ˢ A →
   290      app (app (app E A) a) b = eqv a b

   628  @[expose] def Declaration.Declares : Declaration → ConstantVal → Prop
   629    | .defnDecl cv _ _, cv' => cv' = cv
   630    | .thmDecl cv _, cv' => cv' = cv
   631    | .opaqueDecl cv _, cv' => cv' = cv

== ConLeche/Cached/Installed.lean#L186-L191
   186  inductive InstallRun : List Declaration → (Nat × FEnv × Array PendingCheck) → CState →
   187      (Nat × FEnv × Array PendingCheck) → CState → Prop where
   188    | nil (p : Nat × FEnv × Array PendingCheck) (s : CState) : InstallRun [] p s p s
   189    | cons {pd : Declaration} {ds : List Declaration} {p p₁ p' : Nat × FEnv × Array PendingCheck}
   190        {s s₁ s' : CState} (h : annotDeclStep mode p pd s = .ok (p₁, s₁))
   191        (rest : InstallRun ds p₁ s₁ p' s') : InstallRun (pd :: ds) p s p' s'

== ConLeche/Cached/Installed.lean#L259-L262
   259  def GroupChecked {ds : List Declaration} (e : InstalledEnv mode ds) (i : Nat) : Prop :=
   260    match e.pend[i]? with
   261    | some pc => ∃ s', checkPending mode e.fe pc {} = .ok ((), s')
   262    | none => True

== ConLeche/Kernel/PropWhen.lean#L1-L40
     1  module
     2  
     3  public import ConLeche.Kernel.Name
     4  
     5  /-!
     6  # The zero-ness datum `PropWhen` — representation, API and laws
     7  (task #161; the small-list constructors, 2026-09-06; the canonical
     8  representation, task #194, 2026-09-06)
     9  
    10  The binder annotation of the validated-annotation design: the reading
    11  of a codomain sort's zero-ness predicate `Z(l) = {φ | eval φ l = 0}`.
    12  
    13  **This module is the datum's whole boundary.**  It owns the
    14  representation, the API that is the only way to build, read and
    15  compare a datum, and — following the `Std.HashMap` pattern that
    16  `CLAUDE.md` licenses for a self-contained data-structure verification
    17  — every law about the datum *alone*.  Downstream never re-proves them
    18  and never sees a constructor:
    19  
    20  * the readout `holds` and its algebra (`holds_inter`,
    21    `holds_bindZ_go`, `holds_ext`);
    22  * the comparison — which is **equality**: `=`/`==`/`DecidableEq`
    23    decide zero-ness agreement at every valuation (`eq_iff_holds`), so
    24    the checker's validation and defeq sites compare with `==` and no
    25    separate comparison exists (task #197 deleted `equiv`);
    26  * the `inter`/`bindZ` algebra the substitution laws rest on
    27    (`inter_assoc`, `bindZ_inter`, `bindZ_go_append`,
    28    `bindZ_congr_names`, `bindZ_unit`, `paramsDefined_inter_of`).
    29  
    30  **Canonical by construction (task #194).**  Every value of the type is
    31  the unique representative of its parameter *set*: the parameter list
    32  is strictly ascending in a total order on names (`Name.cmp`, defined
    33  here), the invariant is carried by the constructors themselves, and
    34  every producer (`ifAllZero`, `inter`, `bindZ`, hence
    35  `Level.zeronessOf`/`Level.substPW`) normalizes.  Consequently
    36  `ifAllZero ps = ifAllZero qs ↔ (∀ n, n ∈ ps ↔ n ∈ qs)`
    37  (`ifAllZero_eq_iff`), `=`/`==`/`DecidableEq`/`Hashable` all decide
    38  zero-ness agreement, and the level-instantiation identity law
    39  (`Level.substPW_self`, `ConLeche/Verify/PropWhen.lean`) holds
    40  unconditionally — amendment 2's counterexample (DESIGN.md, task #161

== ConLeche/Term/Syntax.lean#L176-L205
   176    deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited
   177  
   178  /-- Terms.  See the module docstring for what is *not* here. -/
   179  inductive Term where
   180    /-- de Bruijn index -/
   181    | bvar (i : Nat)
   182    /-- `Sort u` at a concrete level -/
   183    | sort (u : Nat)
   184    /-- a built-in constant at a concrete level instantiation -/
   185    | const (c : BConst) (us : List Nat)
   186    /-- application -/
   187    | app (f a : Term)
   188    /-- `fun (_ : ty) => body` -/
   189    | lam (ty body : Term)
   190    /-- `(_ : ty) → body` -/
   191    | pi (ty body : Term)
   192    /-- `@Eq _ lhs rhs`, **without the type**: the interpretation is
   193    `⟦eqE a b⟧ = eqv ⟦a⟧ ⟦b⟧`, so soundness never constrains the type,
   194    and a census (task #237) found no definition and no theorem in any
   195    tier reading the slot the former used to carry.  It is gone; a
   196    producer that knows the type simply drops it. -/
   197    | eqE (lhs rhs : Term)
   198    /-- First field of a pair.  Carries **only** the subject: the pair's
   199    type arguments come from the typing premise `Γ ⊢ p : PSigma' A B`,
   200    not from the term — see the module docstring.  Interpreted by
   201    `sfst`, i.e. literally `interpExpr`'s clause. -/
   202    | fst (e : Term)
   203    /-- Second field of a pair; the `fst` twin, interpreted by `ssnd`. -/
   204    | snd (e : Term)
   205    /-- the canonical (irrelevant) proof of a derivable equation -/

== ConLeche/Semantics/Syntax.lean#L72-L98
    72    | const (c : BConst) (us : List Nat)
    73    /-- application -/
    74    | app (f a : AnnotTerm)
    75    /-- `fun (_ : ty) => body`, where `body`'s **type** has sort `u` —
    76    the codomain numeral `interp` dispatches on (tier B's F4; the
    77    #152 resolution made it derivable, and `Annotates.lam` caches it) -/
    78    | lam (u : Nat) (ty body : AnnotTerm)
    79    /-- `(_ : ty) → body`, with `ty`'s sort `u` and `body`'s sort `v` -/
    80    | pi (u v : Nat) (ty body : AnnotTerm)
    81    /-- `@Eq _ lhs rhs`; no annotation, and no type slot either, as in
    82    `Term` (task #237) -/
    83    | eqE (lhs rhs : AnnotTerm)
    84    /-- first field of a pair -/
    85    | fst (e : AnnotTerm)
    86    /-- second field of a pair -/
    87    | snd (e : AnnotTerm)
    88    /-- the canonical (irrelevant) proof of a derivable equation -/
    89    | prf
    90    deriving Repr, Inhabited

    97    | .sort u => .sort u
    98    | .const c us => .const c us

== ConLeche/Semantics/Interp.lean#L153-L164
   153    | _, .const c us => bval V c us
   154    | ρ, .app f a => SetTheory.app (interp ρ f) (interp ρ a)

   156    | ρ, .pi _ v A B => piR v (interp ρ A) fun x => interp (cons x ρ) B
   157    | ρ, .eqE a b => eqv (interp ρ a) (interp ρ b)

== ConLeche/Semantics/WellDenoted.lean#L81-L111
    81  def WellDenoted : (Nat → V) → AnnotTerm → Prop
    82    | ρ, .pi _u _v A B =>
    83      WellDenoted ρ A ∧
    84      ∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp V ρ A → WellDenoted (cons x ρ) B
    85    | ρ, .lam v A b =>
    86      WellDenoted ρ A ∧
    87      (∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp V ρ A → WellDenoted (cons x ρ) b) ∧
    88      ∃ B : V → V,
    89        (∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp V ρ A → interp V (cons x ρ) b ∈ˢ B x) ∧
    90        (v = 0 → ∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp V ρ A → B x ∈ˢ (univZero : V))
    91    | ρ, .app f a =>
    92      WellDenoted ρ f ∧ WellDenoted ρ a ∧
    93      ∃ (v : Nat) (A : V) (B : V → V),
    94        interp V ρ f ∈ˢ piR v A B ∧ interp V ρ a ∈ˢ A ∧
    95        (v = 0 → ∀ x, x ∈ˢ A → B x ∈ˢ (univZero : V))
    96    | ρ, .fst e =>
    97      WellDenoted ρ e ∧
    98      ∃ u v A Bf, interp V ρ e ∈ˢ sigmaSet (Nat.max u v) A Bf ∧
    99        A ∈ˢ univ u ∧ ∀ x, x ∈ˢ A → Bf x ∈ˢ univ v
   100    | ρ, .snd e =>
   101      WellDenoted ρ e ∧
   102      ∃ u v A Bf, interp V ρ e ∈ˢ sigmaSet (Nat.max u v) A Bf ∧
   103        A ∈ˢ univ u ∧ ∀ x, x ∈ˢ A → Bf x ∈ˢ univ v
   104    | ρ, .eqE a b => WellDenoted ρ a ∧ WellDenoted ρ b
   105    | _, .bvar _ => True
   106    | _, .sort _ => True
   107    | _, .const _ _ => True
   108    | _, .prf => True
   109

   111

   303    have haA : interp V ρ a ∈ˢ interp V ρ A := by
   304      rw [hAA]
   305      exact hmem
   306    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
   307    · rw [interp_app, interp_lam, app_lamR_pos hv haA, interp_inst0]

   311  /-- The graded β step at kind `0` — the residue side: with the
   312  argument membership supplied (the retained `Prop`-codomain runtime
   313  check's fact), the equality holds because both sides are the canonical
   314  proof, and the transport is the hereditary component. -/
   315  theorem WellDenoted_beta_zero {A b a : AnnotTerm} {ρ : Nat → V}
   316      (h : WellDenoted V ρ (.app (.lam 0 A b) a))
   317      (hmem : interp V ρ a ∈ˢ interp V ρ A) :
   318      interp V ρ (.app (.lam 0 A b) a) = interp V ρ (b.inst a) ∧
   319      WellDenoted V ρ (b.inst a) := by
   320    rw [WellDenoted_app] at h
   321    obtain ⟨hlam, ha, -⟩ := h
   322    rw [WellDenoted_lam] at hlam
   323    obtain ⟨-, hbody, B, hfib, hz⟩ := hlam
   324    refine ⟨?_, (WellDenoted_inst0 V ha).mpr (hbody _ hmem)⟩
   325    rw [interp_app, interp_lam, lamR_zero, app_pt, interp_inst0]
   326    exact (eq_pt_of_mem_univZero (hz rfl _ hmem) (hfib _ hmem)).symm

   328  /-! ## The app slot's establishment
   329  
   330  The clause's kind-`0` fibre component (added at the consumer seal —
   331  see the module docstring) is not a wish: it is exactly what an
   332  *annotated* `Π` hands over at the application site.  Stated at the
   333  value level, so the supplier is a theorem before the clause that
   334  consumes it is relied on. -/
   335  
   336  /-- **The app slot, established from the function type's own
   337  annotation.**  Given the function in an annotated `Π`'s
   338  interpretation, the argument in its domain, and the `Π`'s *codomain
   339  sort fact at kind `0`*, the slot follows — new component included.
   340  
   341  The codomain premise's supplier is `HasSort.mem_univ`
   342  (`ConLeche/SetR/Annot/Kinding.lean`) at the `Π`'s own numeral `v`,
   343  which is the same route `Annotates.lam`'s cached `HasSortC` takes for
   344  the λ clause's identically-shaped component.  So the two binder
   345  clauses are symmetric, which is what the amendment restores. -/
   346  theorem appSlot_of_pi {u v : Nat} {ρ : Nat → V} {f a Aa Ba : AnnotTerm}
   347      (hf : interp V ρ f ∈ˢ interp V ρ (.pi u v Aa Ba))
   348      (ha : interp V ρ a ∈ˢ interp V ρ Aa)
   349      (hcod : v = 0 → ∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp V ρ Aa →
   350        interp V (cons x ρ) Ba ∈ˢ (univZero : V)) :

   352        interp V ρ f ∈ˢ piR v' A B ∧ interp V ρ a ∈ˢ A ∧
   353        (v' = 0 → ∀ x, x ∈ˢ A → B x ∈ˢ (univZero : V)) := by
   354    rw [interp_pi] at hf
   355    exact ⟨v, interp V ρ Aa, fun x => interp V (cons x ρ) Ba,
   356      hf, ha, hcod⟩

== ConLeche/Model/Annot/EnvModel.lean#L64-L100
    64  structure EnvModel (env : Env) where
    65    /-- the shared, model-free environment well-formedness -/
    66    wf : EnvWF env
    67    /-- the annotated valuation -/
    68    acval : Name → (Name → Nat) → AnnotTerm
    69    /-- every erased leaf is closed (`EnvS.cval_closed`, at `cvalE`);
    70    consumers read the `cvalE`-spelled `cval_closed` below -/
    71    cval_closedL : ∀ (n : Name) (ψ : Name → Nat),
    72      Term.Closed ((acval n ψ).erase)
    73    /-- the reserved basis constants are the pinned declarations, valued
    74    by their direct pins (V-free, shared with the TT lane); consumers
    75    read the `cvalE`-spelled `basis_pinned` below -/
    76    basis_pinnedL : BasisPinnedTT env (fun n ψ => (acval n ψ).erase)
    77    /-- every stored native projection-table entry is a pinned pair
    78    entry with its block stored (V-free, shared) -/
    79    proj_ok : ProjOkT env
    80    /-- every stored recursor rule's constructor is stored (V-free,
    81    shared) -/
    82    rec_ctors : RecCtorsStored env
    83    /-- every leaf is closed, as a lifting equation -/
    84    acval_closed : ∀ (n : Name) (ψ : Name → Nat) (k : Nat),
    85      (acval n ψ).liftN 1 k = acval n ψ
    86    /-- a leaf reads only its own level parameters -/
    87    acval_params : ∀ (n : Name) (ci : ConstantInfo),
    88      env.find? n = some ci →
    89      ∀ ψ₁ ψ₂ : Name → Nat,
    90        (∀ p ∈ ci.toConstantVal.levelParams, ψ₁ p = ψ₂ p) →
    91        acval n ψ₁ = acval n ψ₂
    92    /-- every leaf is truthful -/
    93    acval_wellDenoted : ∀ (n : Name) (ψ : Name → Nat) (ρ : Nat → V),
    94      WellDenoted V ρ (acval n ψ)

== ConLeche/Model/Claims.lean#L92-L160
    92  @[expose] def WhnfCoreClaim (μ : CheckMode) {env : Env} (m : EnvModel V env)
    93      (φ : Name → Nat) (fuel : Nat) : Prop :=
    94    ∀ {d : Nat} {e e' : Expr} {Δa : List AnnotTerm},
    95      whnfCore μ env fuel d e = .ok e' →
    96      Expr.WScoped d e → e.looseBVarsBounded 0 = true →
    97      Expr.LeavesBounded e →
    98      ∀ {ea ea' : AnnotTerm},
    99        CtxOk m φ d Δa e →
   100        denoteMeta m.acval env φ d e = some ea →
   101        denoteMeta m.acval env φ d e' = some ea' →
   102        (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → WellDenotedV V ρ ea) →
   103        (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → WellDenotedV V ρ ea') ∧
   104          ∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ →
   105            interp V ρ ea = interp V ρ ea'
   106  
   107  /-- The reduction loop, dual success, P currency. -/
   108  @[expose] def WhnfClaim (μ : CheckMode) {env : Env} (m : EnvModel V env)
   109      (φ : Name → Nat) (fuel : Nat) : Prop :=
   110    ∀ {d : Nat} {e e' : Expr} {Δa : List AnnotTerm},
   111      whnf μ env fuel d e = .ok e' →
   112      Expr.WScoped d e → e.looseBVarsBounded 0 = true →
   113      Expr.LeavesBounded e →
   114      ∀ {ea ea' : AnnotTerm},
   115        CtxOk m φ d Δa e →
   116        denoteMeta m.acval env φ d e = some ea →
   117        denoteMeta m.acval env φ d e' = some ea' →
   118        (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → WellDenotedV V ρ ea) →
   119        (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → WellDenotedV V ρ ea') ∧
   120          ∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ →
   121            interp V ρ ea = interp V ρ ea'
   122  
   123  /-- Definitional equality, P currency. -/
   124  @[expose] def DefEqClaim (μ : CheckMode) {env : Env} (m : EnvModel V env)
   125      (φ : Name → Nat) (fuel : Nat) : Prop :=
   126    ∀ {d : Nat} {a b : Expr} {Δa : List AnnotTerm},
   127      ConLeche.isDefEqCore μ env fuel d a b = .ok true →
   128      Expr.WScoped d a → a.looseBVarsBounded 0 = true →
   129      Expr.LeavesBounded a →
   130      Expr.WScoped d b → b.looseBVarsBounded 0 = true →
   131      Expr.LeavesBounded b →
   132      ∀ {aa ba : AnnotTerm},
   133        CtxOk m φ d Δa a →
   134        CtxOk m φ d Δa b →
   135        denoteMeta m.acval env φ d a = some aa →
   136        denoteMeta m.acval env φ d b = some ba →
   137        (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → WellDenotedV V ρ aa) →
   138        (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → WellDenotedV V ρ ba) →
   139        ∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ →
   140          interp V ρ aa = interp V ρ ba
   141  
   142  /-- Inference, dual success, P currency: the subject's and the
   143  type's truthfulness — bit validity included — are *conclusions*. -/
   144  @[expose] def InferClaim (μ : CheckMode) {env : Env} (m : EnvModel V env)
   145      (φ : Name → Nat) (fuel : Nat) : Prop :=
   146    ∀ {d : Nat} {e t : Expr} {Δa : List AnnotTerm},
   147      inferTypeCore μ env fuel d e = .ok t →
   148      Expr.WScoped d e → e.looseBVarsBounded 0 = true →
   149      Expr.LeavesBounded e →
   150      ∀ {ea ta : AnnotTerm},
   151        CtxOk m φ d Δa e →
   152        denoteMeta m.acval env φ d e = some ea →
   153        denoteMeta m.acval env φ d t = some ta →
   154        (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → WellDenotedV V ρ ea) ∧
   155          (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → WellDenotedV V ρ ta) ∧
   156          ∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ →
   157            interp V ρ ea ∈ˢ interp V ρ ta

== ConLeche/Kernel/Core.lean#L567-L575

== ConLeche/Kernel/Core.lean#L499-L516
   499  /-! ## Structural-Nat literal acceleration
   500  
   501  The official kernel accelerates the structural `Nat` operations on
   502  literals (GMP-backed there).  Here the fast path is *certified*: an
   503  operation participates only when its defining recurrence equations
   504  hold by definitional equality — checked once, at install: `checkDecl`
   505  positively rejects a nonstandard definition under one of these names,
   506  so *presence in the store is the certificate* (no runtime flag, no
   507  re-checking; a reduction-time re-check would in fact livelock — the
   508  certification's own `pred zero` equation re-enters the fast path).
   509  
   510  The certification runs in the environment *before* the operation is
   511  stored, on the equations with the operation's self-references replaced
   512  by its (annotated) definition value (`Expr.substConst0`): running it
   513  after insertion would let the operation's own just-enabled fast path
   514  discharge its all-literal-argument equations (`pred zero ≡ zero`,
   515  `beq zero zero ≡ true`) vacuously — accepting definitions that
   516  disagree with the fast path on those points, which is unsound.  The

== ConLeche/Kernel/Checker.lean#L110-L117
   110  def certifyNatEqs (ops : CheckerOps m) (env : Env) :
   111      List (Expr × Expr) → m Bool
   112    | [] => pure true
   113    | eq :: rest => do
   114      if ← ops.isDefEq env 2 eq.1 eq.2 then
   115        certifyNatEqs ops env rest
   116      else pure false
   117

== ConLeche/Kernel/Core.lean#L577-L592
   577  /-- The WF-recursive operations with a *pinned-declaration* certified
   578  fast path: at install, `checkDecl` compares the stream's definition
   579  against a vendored pin of the toolchain's own (helper-unfolded)
   580  definition by definitional equality, and then checks the pinned
   581  `Nat.ble`-guarded characterization certificates
   582  (`ConLeche/Kernel/NatOpPins.lean`) like theorem declarations — without
   583  installing them.  Presence in the store is therefore again the
   584  capability: a stored operation under one of these names has passed pin
   585  and certificates, or the install declined.  (The name is historic:
   586  the family started with `Nat.div`/`Nat.mod` and now covers every
   587  pin-certified WF-recursive kernel-accelerated `Nat` operation —
   588  `Nat.log2` left the list when its fast path did, official folding no
   589  unary operation but `Nat.succ`.) -/

== ConLeche/PinGen/Certs.lean#L7-L18
     7  /-!
     8  # Certificate theorems for the pin-certified Nat operations (elab-time)
     9  
    10  The characterization certificates of the pin-certified WF-recursive
    11  `Nat` operations, elaborated against the ambient *toolchain* prelude,
    12  where `Nat.div`/`Nat.mod`/… are the real operations.  The *statements*
    13  fix the pinned spellings: guards via the already-certified `Nat.ble`
    14  (never the `Nat.le`/`Nat.lt` `Prop` inductives), numerals via
    15  `Nat.succ`/`Nat.zero` (never `OfNat`), so the model-side consumption
    16  rides the existing `NatOpsOk` literal semantics.
    17

== ConLeche/SetTheory/Core.lean#L95-L156
    95  /-- A model of set theory of exactly the strength the checker needs:
    96  membership, the six ZF⁻ axioms (extensionality, pairing, union, power
    97  set, regularity, Lean-level replacement), and an ω-chain of
    98  Grothendieck universes.  Infinity is derivable; choice is inherited
    99  from the meta-logic (`Classical.choice`); see the module docstring. -/
   100  class SetTheory (V : Type u) where
   101    /-- Set membership. -/
   102    Mem : V → V → Prop
   103    /-- Extensionality: sets with the same members are equal. -/
   104    ext : ∀ {x y : V}, (∀ z, Mem z x ↔ Mem z y) → x = y
   105    /-- Pairing: the unordered pair. -/
   106    upair : V → V → V
   107    /-- Characterization of the unordered pair. -/
   108    mem_upair : ∀ {z a b : V}, Mem z (upair a b) ↔ z = a ∨ z = b
   109    /-- Union: the union of the members. -/
   110    sUnion : V → V
   111    /-- Characterization of the union. -/
   112    mem_sUnion : ∀ {z x : V}, Mem z (sUnion x) ↔ ∃ y, Mem y x ∧ Mem z y
   113    /-- Power set. -/
   114    power : V → V
   115    /-- Characterization of the power set: members are the subsets. -/
   116    mem_power : ∀ {z x : V}, Mem z (power x) ↔ ∀ w, Mem w z → Mem w x
   117    /-- Regularity: every nonempty set has an `∈`-minimal member. -/
   118    regularity : ∀ x : V, (∃ y, Mem y x) → ∃ y, Mem y x ∧ ¬ ∃ z, Mem z y ∧ Mem z x
   119    /-- Replacement, as a Lean-level scheme: the image of a set under an
   120    arbitrary function `V → V`. -/
   121    image : (V → V) → V → V
   122    /-- Characterization of the replacement image. -/
   123    mem_image : ∀ {f : V → V} {a z : V}, Mem z (image f a) ↔ ∃ w, Mem w a ∧ z = f w
   124    /-- An ω-chain of Grothendieck universes: the sets interpreting the
   125    universe tower (Carneiro's ω-many inaccessibles, op. cit.;
   126    intended model `V_{κ n}`). -/
   127    univChain : Nat → V
   128    /-- The chain increases strictly: each universe is a member of the
   129    next. -/
   130    univChain_mem : ∀ n : Nat, Mem (univChain n) (univChain (n + 1))
   131    /-- Each chain member is a Grothendieck universe (Tarski's Axiom A
   132    matrix with transitivity, `IsTGUniverse`). -/
   133    univChain_tg : ∀ n : Nat, IsTGUniverse Mem (univChain n)
   134  
   135  namespace SetTheory
   136  
   137  @[inherit_doc] scoped infix:50 " ∈ˢ " => Mem
   138  
   139  variable {V : Type u} [SetTheory V]
   140  
   141  /-- Subset, from membership. -/
   142  protected def Subset (x y : V) : Prop := ∀ z, z ∈ˢ x → z ∈ˢ y
   143  
   144  @[inherit_doc] scoped infix:50 " ⊆ˢ " => SetTheory.Subset
   145  
   146  theorem Subset.refl (x : V) : x ⊆ˢ x := fun _ hz => hz
   147  
   148  theorem Subset.trans {x y z : V} (h₁ : x ⊆ˢ y) (h₂ : y ⊆ˢ z) : x ⊆ˢ z :=
   149    fun w hw => h₂ w (h₁ w hw)
   150  
   151  theorem Subset.antisymm {x y : V} (h₁ : x ⊆ˢ y) (h₂ : y ⊆ˢ x) : x = y :=
   152    ext fun z => ⟨h₁ z, h₂ z⟩
   153  
   154  theorem mem_power_iff_subset {z x : V} : z ∈ˢ power x ↔ z ⊆ˢ x := mem_power
   155  
   156  end SetTheory

== ConLeche/Kernel/TrustAxioms.lean#L10-L38
    10  /-!
    11  # The compiler-trust axiom family (task #95)
    12  
    13  `Init`'s compiler-trust scaffolding is installed rather than
    14  declined:
    15  
    16  * `Lean.trustCompiler : True` is trivially realizable — it is
    17    installed as an *opaque* (stored `thmInfo`, exactly like a checked
    18    `opaque` declaration) with value `True.intro`, over a pinned `True`
    19    family.  No new meta-axiom: the model is `True.intro`'s own
    20    interpretation.
    21  * `Lean.reduceNat` / `Lean.reduceBool` then check as ordinary
    22    `opaque`s (their exported values are identity functions modulo the
    23    `have := trustCompiler` wrapper); at install their stored values are
    24    pinned against the identity function
    25    (`ConLeche/Kernel/TrustPins.lean`, hand-pinned since task #273 —
    26    every toolchain's definition after zeta) by definitional equality —
    27    the task-#47 pattern: drift declines, never silently.
    28  * `Lean.ofReduceNat` / `Lean.ofReduceBool` are pinned axioms over
    29    those stored opaques (the task-#34 standard-axioms machinery).  With
    30    the stored reduce operation certified to be the identity (a
    31    definitional-equality certificate at the axiom's own install,
    32    `checkOfReduceAx`), `∀ a b, reduceNat a = b → a = b` interprets to
    33    an inhabited proposition (the hypothesis *is* the conclusion), so
    34    both axioms are true in the set model with the proof point as value.
    35  
    36  `sorryAx` remains the only axiom tolerated as a *declaration*: its
    37  record installs nothing and any use of it declines
    38  (`sorryAxName`, `ConLeche/Kernel/Basis/Names.lean`).
